next.reason: 1985 data division: FILE SECTION (file-description-entry {record-description-entry} …, sort-merge entries, report-file-description-entry), WORKING-STORAGE, LINKAGE, COMMUNICATION and REPORT sections. §2023:13.2.1 (with the section formats §2023:13.4.2, §2023:13.5.2, §2023:13.7.2 and §2023:13.8.2 restating it) has no COMMUNICATION SECTION, so a 1985 program with one is refused; it lets a file-description-entry have no record-description-entry ([ … ] …), adds constant-entry and type-declaration-entry, and adds LOCAL-STORAGE and SCREEN sections. Compile-time only.
